text: {"label":"Certification, Licensure, and Professional Ethics","definition":"Work on credentialing and regulating practicing behavior analysts, including certification board updates, licensure efforts, ethics and compliance codes, ethical dilemmas in practice, and standards for supervising trainees seeking certification.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centers on credentialing, licensure, ethics codes, and certification supervision requirements, not general professional development of behavior analysts, academic program curricula, or behavioral skills training methods."}
